consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-3100 and TX-3001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 12 January 2006 a near hit was recorded on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
